dct_description_sm: Georeferenced map of Okanagan Band reserves Okanagan 1, Otter Lake 2, Harris 3, Swan Lake 4 and Priest's Valley 6 in the area surrounding north Okanagan Lake including Long Lake, Otter Lake, and Swan Lakes. Land cover and features include beaver dams, fields, graves, south boundary of the Railway Belt, villages, trail from Cherry Creek to Kamloops and the types of land, soil, and timber. Place names include Deep Creek, Kullsenom Lake, Meadow Creek, Ne-whoot Creek, Priest's Valley, Round Lake, Salmon River and Tsinthle-kap-a-lux Creek.
